alternate_names: Maharani Vaishno Devi Mandir, NIT Faridabad

history.summary: A popular modern Devi temple on Deep Chand Bhatia Marg in New Industrial Township-1 (NIT-1), Faridabad, near Tikona Park. It is a well-rated local shrine (about 4.6/5 across ~4,000 ratings) drawing devotees from NIT and greater Faridabad. No published history or founding date was found for this temple (UNVERIFIED); it is not to be confused with the famous Vaishno Devi shrine at Katra, Jammu.

name: Shri Maharani Vaishno Devi Mandir
town_description: Faridabad is Haryana's largest city and a major industrial hub on Delhi's southeastern edge, part of the Delhi NCR. It was founded in 1607 by Shaikh Farid (Mughal emperor Jahangir's treasurer) as Farid's town. The NIT (New Industrial Township) area, developed in the 1950s for Partition refugees, is one of its oldest planned quarters.

travel.railway: Faridabad Railway Station - about 0.9 km (verify); Bata Chowk Metro Station - about 0.9 km (verify).
travel.road: 97MX+V53, Deep Chand Bhatia Marg, New Industrial Twp 1, NIT Faridabad, Haryana 121001; reachable by auto, taxi and metro.
